observations.definition:
name: live-agi-development

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      provider:
        description: Live model provider; auto prefers OpenAI when its repository secret is configured
        required: true
        default: auto
        type: choice
        options:
          - auto
          - openai
          - copilot
      openai_model:
        description: OpenAI API model alias or snapshot
        required: true
        default: gpt-5
        type: string
      copilot_model:
        description: GitHub Copilot model identifier
        required: true
        default: gpt-5.4
        type: string
      runs:
        description: Number of repeated campaign runs
        required: true
        default: '2'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  copilot-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: live-agi-development
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  campaign:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      OPENAI_MODEL: ${{ inputs.openai_model }}
      COPILOT_MODEL: ${{ inputs.copilot_model }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
      - run: python -m pip install -e '.[test]'
      - name: Resolve bounded live provider
        id: provider
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${{ inputs.runs }}" in
            1|2|3|4|5) ;;
            *) echo "runs must be an integer from 1 through 5" >&2; exit 2 ;;
          esac
          requested="${{ inputs.provider }}"
          case "${requested}" in
            auto)
              if [[ -n "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
                resolved=openai
              else
                resolved=copilot
              fi
              ;;
            openai)
              if [[ -z "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
                echo "provider=openai requires OPENAI_API_KEY repository secret." >&2
                exit 1
              fi
              resolved=openai
              ;;
            copilot) resolved=copilot ;;
            *) echo "unsupported provider: ${requested}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
          esac
          echo "provider=${resolved}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Install Copilot SDK only for Copilot trial
        if: steps.provider.outputs.provider == 'copilot'
        run: python -m pip install 'github-copilot-sdk>=1.0.8,<2'
      - name: Run OpenAI repeated capability campaign
        if: steps.provider.outputs.provider == 'openai'
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          campaign_id="openai-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          output_dir=".continual/evidence/campaigns/${campaign_id}"
          mkdir -p "${output_dir}"
          campaign_status=0
          longhorizon_status=0
          set +e
          agi-benchmark run-campaign-openai \
            --model "${OPENAI_MODEL}" \
            --runs "${{ inputs.runs }}" \
            --campaign-id "${campaign_id}" \
            --output-dir "${output_dir}"
          campaign_status=$?
          agi-longhorizon run-openai \
            --model "${OPENAI_MODEL}" \
            --instances 3 \
            --output-dir "${output_dir}/longhorizon"
          longhorizon_status=$?
          set -e
          printf '{"campaign_exit_code":%d,"longhorizon_exit_code":%d}\n' \
            "${campaign_status}" "${longhorizon_status}" \
            > "${output_dir}/request-stage-status.json"
          if (( campaign_status != 0 || longhorizon_status != 0 )); then
            echo "OpenAI live development failed: campaign=${campaign_status} longhorizon=${longhorizon_status}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Run Copilot SDK repeated capability and retention campaign
        if: steps.provider.outputs.provider == 'copilot'
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          campaign_id="copilot-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          output_dir=".continual/evidence/campaigns/${campaign_id}"
          mkdir -p "${output_dir}"
          campaign_status=0
          longhorizon_status=0
          set +e
          agi-copilot run-campaign \
            --model "${COPILOT_MODEL}" \
            --runs "${{ inputs.runs }}" \
            --campaign-id "${campaign_id}" \
            --output-dir "${output_dir}"
          campaign_status=$?
          agi-copilot run-longhorizon \
            --model "${COPILOT_MODEL}" \
            --instances 3 \
            --output-dir "${output_dir}/longhorizon"
          longhorizon_status=$?
          set -e
          printf '{"campaign_exit_code":%d,"longhorizon_exit_code":%d}\n' \
            "${campaign_status}" "${longhorizon_status}" \
            > "${output_dir}/request-stage-status.json"
          if (( campaign_status != 0 || longhorizon_status != 0 )); then
            echo "Copilot live development failed: campaign=${campaign_status} longhorizon=${longhorizon_status}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: live-agi-development-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .continual/evidence/campaigns/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

observations.definition:
name: live-agi-request

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'agi/live-campaign-*'
    paths:
      - 'agi/LIVE_CAMPAIGN_REQUEST.json'

permissions:
  contents: read
  statuses: write
  copilot-requests: write

concurrency:
  group: live-agi-request-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  campaign:
    if: github.actor == github.repository_owner
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          cache: pip
      - run: python -m pip install -e '.[test]'
      - name: Validate bounded request
        id: request
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python - <<'PY' >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          import json
          import re
          from pathlib import Path

          from agi.sandbox_protocol import MIN_REPEATED_INSTANCES

          path = Path('agi/LIVE_CAMPAIGN_REQUEST.json')
          value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
          if not isinstance(value, dict) or value.get('schema_version') != 1:
              raise SystemExit('request must be a schema_version=1 object')
          allowed = {'schema_version', 'provider', 'model', 'runs', 'longhorizon_instances', 'purpose'}
          unknown = sorted(set(value) - allowed)
          if unknown:
              raise SystemExit('unknown request keys: ' + ', '.join(unknown))
          provider = value.get('provider')
          if provider not in {'auto', 'openai', 'copilot'}:
              raise SystemExit('provider must be one of: auto, openai, copilot')
          model = value.get('model')
          if not isinstance(model, str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]{0,79}', model):
              raise SystemExit('model must be a bounded public identifier')
          runs = value.get('runs')
          instances = value.get('longhorizon_instances')
          if not isinstance(runs, int) or isinstance(runs, bool) or not 1 <= runs <= 3:
              raise SystemExit('runs must be an integer from 1 through 3')
          if (
              not isinstance(instances, int)
              or isinstance(instances, bool)
              or not MIN_REPEATED_INSTANCES <= instances <= 3
          ):
              raise SystemExit(
                  f'longhorizon_instances must be an integer from {MIN_REPEATED_INSTANCES} through 3'
              )
          purpose = value.get('purpose', '')
          if not isinstance(purpose, str) or len(purpose) > 300:
              raise SystemExit('purpose must be a string of at most 300 characters')
          print(f'provider={provider}')
          print(f'model={model}')
          print(f'runs={runs}')
          print(f'instances={instances}')
          PY
      - name: Publish pending request status
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: python -m agi.live_request_status pending
      - name: Resolve bounded live provider
        id: provider
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          REQUESTED_PROVIDER: ${{ steps.request.outputs.provider }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${REQUESTED_PROVIDER}" in
            auto)
              if [[ -n "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
                resolved=openai
              else
                resolved=copilot
              fi
              ;;
            openai)
              if [[ -z "${OPENAI_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
                echo "provider=openai requires OPENAI_API_KEY repository secret." >&2
                exit 1
              fi
              resolved=openai
              ;;
            copilot) resolved=copilot ;;
            *) echo "unsupported provider after validation: ${REQUESTED_PROVIDER}" >&2; exit 2 ;;
          esac
          echo "provider=${resolved}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Install Copilot SDK only for Copilot request
        if: steps.provider.outputs.provider == 'copilot'
        run: python -m pip install 'github-copilot-sdk>=1.0.8,<2'
      - name: Run bounded OpenAI capability and retention request
        if: steps.provider.outputs.provider == 'openai'
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          MODEL: ${{ steps.request.outputs.model }}
          RUNS: ${{ steps.request.outputs.runs }}
          INSTANCES: ${{ steps.request.outputs.instances }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          campaign_id="openai-request-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          output_dir=".continual/evidence/campaigns/${campaign_id}"
          mkdir -p "${output_dir}"
          campaign_status=0
          longhorizon_status=0
          set +e
          agi-benchmark run-campaign-openai \
            --model "${MODEL}" \
            --runs "${RUNS}" \
            --campaign-id "${campaign_id}" \
            --output-dir "${output_dir}"
          campaign_status=$?
          agi-longhorizon run-openai \
            --model "${MODEL}" \
            --instances "${INSTANCES}" \
            --output-dir "${output_dir}/longhorizon"
          longhorizon_status=$?
          set -e
          printf '{"campaign_exit_code":%d,"longhorizon_exit_code":%d}\n' \
            "${campaign_status}" "${longhorizon_status}" \
            > "${output_dir}/request-stage-status.json"
          if (( campaign_status != 0 || longhorizon_status != 0 )); then
            echo "bounded OpenAI live request failed: campaign=${campaign_status} longhorizon=${longhorizon_status}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - name: Run bounded Copilot capability and retention request
        if: steps.provider.outputs.provider == 'copilot'
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MODEL: ${{ steps.request.outputs.model }}
          RUNS: ${{ steps.request.outputs.runs }}
          INSTANCES: ${{ steps.request.outputs.instances }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          campaign_id="copilot-request-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
          output_dir=".continual/evidence/campaigns/${campaign_id}"
          mkdir -p "${output_dir}"
          campaign_status=0
          longhorizon_status=0
          set +e
          agi-copilot run-campaign \
            --model "${MODEL}" \
            --runs "${RUNS}" \
            --campaign-id "${campaign_id}" \
            --output-dir "${output_dir}"
          campaign_status=$?
          agi-copilot run-longhorizon \
            --model "${MODEL}" \
            --instances "${INSTANCES}" \
            --output-dir "${output_dir}/longhorizon"
          longhorizon_status=$?
          set -e
          printf '{"campaign_exit_code":%d,"longhorizon_exit_code":%d}\n' \
            "${campaign_status}" "${longhorizon_status}" \
            > "${output_dir}/request-stage-status.json"
          if (( campaign_status != 0 || longhorizon_status != 0 )); then
            echo "bounded Copilot live request failed: campaign=${campaign_status} longhorizon=${longhorizon_status}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: live-agi-request-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .continual/evidence/campaigns/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Publish final request status
        if: always()
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          JOB_STATUS: ${{ job.status }}
        run: python -m agi.live_request_status final --job-status "${JOB_STATUS}"
